name: system.lock
description: Lock the workstation. Equivalent to Win+L — the user must re-authenticate to resume.

x-output-schema.description: Empty body — wire response is the literal `OK 0`.

x-implementations.name: lockworkstation
x-implementations.description: Win32 `LockWorkStation`. Always present on NT 5+, on NT 4 SP4 and later via the workstation lock dialog.

windows-modern.description: Single `LockWorkStation` call. Returns immediately; the actual lock happens asynchronously on the desktop switching thread.

windows-classic.description: Single `LockWorkStation` call. Available on NT 4 SP4+, 2000, XP, Vista, 7, 8, 8.1. Pre-SP4 NT 4 returns `ERR not_supported`.
